flags.headline: AEM — persisting RED: Barnat pit wall movement suspends mining at Canadian Malartic, guidance cut extends into 2027-28
flags.detail: No new trading session since Thursday's close and no new development beyond what's already been reported: a July 1 rock mass movement on the Barnat open pit's north wall (Canadian Malartic, Quebec) forced a precautionary suspension of in-pit mining there — no injuries, equipment damage, or environmental impact. Agnico expects H2 2026 production to fall ~60,000-80,000 oz, with 2027-2028 production potentially reduced by up to ~150,000 oz/year pending an ongoing geotechnical assessment. The Odyssey mine and the long-term ~1Moz/yr Canadian Malartic complex target (early 2030s) are stated to be unaffected. Formal updated guidance is due with Q2 2026 results, after market close July 29, 2026.
flags.thesis_link: Matches AEM key_risk: "any execution miss on the 4M+ oz production target ... could trigger meaningful valuation compression" — a confirmed multi-year production cut at a flagship asset is that execution-miss risk materializing.

flags.headline: FTNT — persisting AMBER: FortiBleed credential-exposure campaign now tied to active INC/Lynx ransomware operations
flags.detail: The 'FortiBleed' campaign (credential harvesting from internet-facing FortiGate devices via reused/weak passwords, not a new Fortinet vulnerability) has widened since first flagged: coverage now estimates 30,000-75,000+ compromised devices across 194 countries (some estimates as high as ~430,000 targeted, 110M+ credentials harvested), and new reporting since last run explicitly ties the harvested credentials to active INC and Lynx ransomware intrusions — an escalation from 'credential exposure' to 'confirmed ransomware staging.' Still not a match to a listed key_risk (FTNT's screener risks are valuation, platform competition, org-scalability) and not yet visible in price (-1.76%, in line with the sector, not an outlier) or analyst grades. Holding at AMBER pending signs of customer churn or contract impact tied specifically to Fortinet.
